prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a hit while turning left. The patient had 16 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1169; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which the patient's vehicle was struck from behind while the patient was turning left. The patient reported immediate onset of neck pain with stiffness and mid-to-low back pain radiating into the right paraspinal region, with headache on the day of the incident. Examination revealed restricted cervical range of motion, tenderness over the cervical and lumbar paraspinal muscles, and muscle guarding without focal neurological deficit. Neurological screening, including reflexes, strength, and sensation in the upper and lower extremities, was within normal limits. Imaging was not indicated at initial evaluation given the absence of red flag findings.

Treatment over the course of care consisted of sixteen visits and included manual therapy, targeted therapeutic exercise for cervical and lumbar stabilization, moist heat, and a home exercise program with postural education. Pain and range of motion improved steadily, and the patient reported a substantial reduction in headache frequency by the midpoint of care. At discharge, the patient had near-full cervical range of motion, residual mild lumbar stiffness with activity, and was independent with the home program. Prognosis is good with continued self-management, and follow-up is recommended as needed for any recurrence of symptoms.
